title: ACR Automotive Digital Catalog
description: A production B2B platform that replaced printed catalogs for a Mexican brake parts distributor. Features a 6-stage intelligent search system enabling retail counter staff to cross-reference competitor SKUs in sub-300ms.

title: Risk Recommendations Platform
description: Enterprise risk management system for a global insurance company. Micro frontend architecture with dual data sources, real-time subscriptions, and CQRS command processing via HotChocolate GraphQL.

title: FORTIFIED Certification Platform
description: Building certification platform supporting disaster-resistant construction. Schema-driven form system with polymorphic domain modeling and 105 conditional validators.
